ParaSkill Med, operated under the aegis of ADWEF, is a distinguished organization registered under the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Section 8, Govt. of India, with License No. 159597. Our commitment to quality and excellence is validated by our ISO 9001: 2015 certification. ParaSkill Med is also registered under the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India (ID: DL/00038266), and NITI Aayog (UID: DL/2024/044329), and is recognized under MSME, reflecting our adherence to professional standards and service excellence. Additionally, we are authorized by UGC-approved universities.

At ParaSkill Med, our mission is to educate and empower individuals in the medical field. We are dedicated to providing high-quality education and training in paramedical sciences through our network of paramedical institutes. Our operations extend to running diagnostic centers, pathology labs, and clinics, delivering essential healthcare services to communities.
